note: Town of Vegreville campground at Pysanka Park (World's Largest Pysanka) on Hwy 16A at the east end of town: two loops either side of the CN rail line inside a bend of the creek, with check-in at the on-site Visitor Information Centre. Stocked trout pond (fishing for seniors and children), paddle boats, mini golf and a playground. Unstaffed 8 PM to 9 AM. Campers must use the designated rail crossing; CN fines up to $500 for crossing the tracks. --Claude

Pin ~180 m off on Hwy 16A. Not waterfront kept.

PIN (53.49020,-112.03820): on Hwy 16A south of the creek, ~180 m from the sites. Let's Camp's own point 53.49156,-112.03966 is in the south loop. Recommend 53.49156,-112.03966 (under the 250 m threshold, but the stored point is on the highway).

WATERFRONT (stored not waterfront - kept): the creek wraps both loops; the south-loop pads are ~20-35 m from it, but the bank is a continuous dense tree band and the channel is under canopy, so there is no open ground to the water. Elks Pond is across the rail line ~250 m+ away (a pond anyway). Nothing to upgrade.
